en: Half cup oat flour
1 egg
100 ml low-fat milk
Half tsp baking powder
Half cup fresh blueberries
Mix the flour and baking powder in a bowl
Add the egg and milk, whisk until smooth
Fold in the blueberries gently
Pour a ladle onto a hot pan and cook 2 minutes per side
1 wholewheat tortilla
2 eggs
Quarter cup black beans
Chopped tomato and bell pepper
1 tsp oil, low-fat cheese
Beat the eggs and scramble with the tomato and pepper 4 minutes
Warm the beans and the tortilla briefly
Layer the egg, beans and cheese on the tortilla
Roll tightly and slice in half
Whole-wheat bread, cubed, 60 g
1 egg and 1 egg white
Low-fat milk 120 ml
A pinch of ground cinnamon and vanilla extract half a tsp
Brown sugar 1 tsp
Light maple syrup 1 tbsp to serve (optional)
Place the bread cubes in a small oven-safe dish.
Whisk the egg and egg white with the milk, cinnamon, vanilla and brown sugar.
Pour the mixture over the bread and press gently to soak it, let it sit 10 minutes.
Bake at 180°C for 20-25 minutes until set and golden, serve with maple syrup if desired.
2 eggs and 2 egg whites
Red bell pepper, diced, and chopped spring onion
Fresh spinach, chopped, 30 g
Low-fat grated cheese 30 g
A little salt and black pepper
1 tsp oil for greasing the muffin tins
Whisk the eggs and egg whites with salt and black pepper.
Add the bell pepper, spring onion, spinach and cheese, mix well.
Pour the mixture into greased muffin tins about three-quarters full.
Bake at 180°C for 18-20 minutes until set and golden on top, serve warm.

name.en: Baked Sweet Potato Hash with Egg

en: Sweet potato, cut into small cubes, 150 g
Green bell pepper, diced, and chopped onion
1 egg
A pinch of smoked paprika, salt and black pepper
1 tsp olive oil
Chopped spring onion for garnish (optional)
Mix the sweet potato, bell pepper and onion with the oil, paprika, salt and black pepper.
Spread on a lined tray in a single layer.
Bake at 200°C for 18-20 minutes, turning halfway, until cooked and golden.
Make a small well in the centre, crack the egg into it, return to the oven for another 5-6 minutes until the white is set, garnish with spring onion and serve.

name.en: Overnight Oats with Peanut Butter and Banana

en: Oats 50 g
Low-fat milk 140 ml
Natural peanut butter 1 tbsp
Half a banana, sliced
Honey 1 tsp
A pinch of ground cinnamon
Place the oats in a jar or lidded container.
Add the milk, peanut butter, honey and cinnamon, mix well.
Cover the container and refrigerate overnight (at least 6 hours).
Before serving, stir the mixture, arrange the banana slices on top and serve cold.

name.en: Baked Spinach and Feta Egg Bake

en: 2 eggs and 2 egg whites
Fresh spinach, chopped, 60 g
Low-fat feta cheese, crumbled, 30 g
Chopped spring onion and cherry tomatoes, halved
A little salt and black pepper
1 tsp oil for greasing the dish
Whisk the eggs and egg whites with salt and black pepper.
Add the spinach, feta and spring onion, mix well.
Pour the mixture into a small greased oven-safe dish.
Arrange the cherry tomatoes on top, bake at 180°C for 20-25 minutes until set and golden, serve warm.
Oats 50 g
1 mashed banana
Low-fat milk 100 ml and 1 egg
Baking powder half a tsp and ground cinnamon half a tsp
Coarsely chopped walnuts 1 tbsp
Honey 1 tsp (optional)
Mix the oats with the mashed banana, milk, egg, baking powder and cinnamon until combined.
Pour into a small oven-safe dish.
Sprinkle the walnuts on top.
Bake at 180°C for 25-30 minutes until set and golden on top, drizzle with honey if desired and serve warm.
2 eggs and 2 egg whites
Low-fat diced turkey ham 50 g
Green bell pepper, diced, and chopped onion
Low-fat milk 2 tbsp
A little salt and black pepper
Low-fat grated cheese 20 g (optional)
Whisk the eggs and egg whites with the milk, salt and black pepper.
Add the turkey ham, bell pepper and onion, mix well.
Pour the mixture into a small oven-safe dish.
Sprinkle with cheese if desired, bake at 180°C for 20-25 minutes until set and golden, serve warm.
Oats 60 g
Low-fat milk 120 ml and 1 egg
Raisins 2 tbsp and ground cinnamon half a tsp
Baking powder half a tsp
Honey 2 tbsp
A pinch of vanilla extract
Mix the oats with the milk, egg, cinnamon, baking powder, honey and vanilla until combined.
Add the raisins and stir gently.
Pour the mixture into lined muffin tins about three-quarters full.
Bake at 180°C for 20-25 minutes until set and golden on top, serve warm.
3 slices wholegrain bread
100 g sliced roasted turkey breast
2 lettuce leaves and tomato slices
1 tsp mustard or yogurt-mustard mix
1 slice low-fat cheese
Toast the three bread slices
Spread mustard on two of them
Layer: bread-turkey-cheese-bread-lettuce and tomato-bread
Cut diagonally in half and secure with a pick
1 cup chopped lettuce
100 g grilled chicken breast, cubed
1 boiled egg
1 tomato and a quarter avocado
1 tbsp balsamic vinegar and olive oil
Lay the lettuce in the base of the plate
Arrange the chicken, egg, tomato and avocado in rows on top
Whisk the vinegar, oil and salt into a dressing
Pour it on just before serving
Chicken breast, sliced, 140 g
Chopped romaine lettuce and halved cherry tomatoes
Low-fat Greek yogurt 2 tbsp and lemon juice 1 tbsp for the dressing
1 crushed garlic clove and grated parmesan 1 tbsp for the dressing
Whole-wheat tortilla, 1 piece (60 g)
Salt, black pepper and 1 tsp oil
Season the chicken with salt, black pepper and oil, bake at 220°C for 15-18 minutes until fully cooked.
Mix the yogurt, lemon juice, garlic and parmesan to make the Caesar dressing.
Spread out the tortilla, arrange the lettuce, tomatoes and baked chicken over it, pour the dressing.
Roll it up tightly into a cylinder, cut in half and serve.
Cooked quinoa 100 g
Canned black beans, drained, 80 g
Canned sweet corn, drained, and diced red bell pepper, 60 g total
Diced tomato, chopped red onion and chopped fresh coriander
Lemon juice 2 tbsp and 1 tsp olive oil
Ground cumin half a tsp, salt and black pepper
Mix the cooked quinoa with the black beans, corn and bell pepper in a large bowl.
Add the tomato, red onion and fresh coriander.
Mix the lemon juice, olive oil, cumin, salt and black pepper to make the dressing.
Pour the dressing over the salad and toss gently, serve at room temperature or cold.
Canned tuna in water, drained, 100 g
Low-fat Greek yogurt 2 tbsp
Chopped celery and chopped spring onion
Lemon juice 1 tsp, salt and black pepper
Whole-wheat bread, 2 slices (70 g)
Low-fat grated cheese 30 g
Mix the tuna with the yogurt, celery, spring onion, lemon juice, salt and black pepper.
Spread the mixture over the two bread slices.
Sprinkle the cheese over them.
Bake at 200°C for 10-12 minutes until the cheese melts and turns golden, serve hot.
Chicken breast, sliced, 140 g
Cooked brown rice 110 g
Broccoli florets and sliced carrot, 150 g total
Low-sodium soy sauce 2 tbsp and 1 crushed garlic clove
Honey 1 tsp and 1 tsp oil
Toasted sesame seeds a pinch for garnish (optional)
Mix the soy sauce, garlic and honey to make the marinade, marinate the chicken in it and let it sit 15 minutes.
Bake the chicken at 220°C for 15-18 minutes until fully cooked.
Steam the broccoli and carrot or cook in a pan with a little oil 5-7 minutes until tender.
Arrange the rice in a serving bowl, add the chicken and vegetables on top, sprinkle with sesame seeds if desired and serve.
Peeled medium shrimp 140 g
Ground cumin, paprika and garlic powder half a tsp each
Lemon juice 1 tbsp and 1 tsp olive oil
Small corn or whole-wheat tortillas, 2 pieces (60 g)
Shredded cabbage and sliced avocado, 60 g total
Low-fat Greek yogurt 2 tbsp to serve
Mix the shrimp with the cumin, paprika, garlic powder, lemon juice and oil.
Arrange in a single layer on a lined tray.
Bake at 220°C for 8-10 minutes until fully cooked.
Warm the tortillas slightly, fill with the shrimp, cabbage and avocado, add the yogurt on top and serve.
Lean beef steak 140 g
Mixed lettuce, chopped, and cherry tomatoes, halved
Sliced mushrooms and sliced red bell pepper, 100 g total
Lemon juice 2 tbsp and 1 tsp olive oil for the dressing
Dijon mustard half a tsp for the dressing
Salt and black pepper
Season the steak with salt and black pepper.
Grill under the broiler or in a hot pan 3-4 minutes on each side depending on desired doneness, let it rest 5 minutes then slice.
Arrange the lettuce, tomatoes, mushrooms and bell pepper in a serving bowl.
Mix the lemon juice, oil and mustard to make the dressing, arrange the steak slices over the salad, pour the dressing and serve.
Chicken breast, sliced, 140 g
Red and green bell pepper and onion, sliced, 150 g total
Ground cumin, paprika and garlic powder half a tsp each
Lemon juice 1 tbsp and 1 tsp olive oil
Cooked brown rice 110 g
Sliced avocado and chopped fresh coriander for garnish
Mix the chicken, bell pepper and onion with the cumin, paprika, garlic powder, lemon juice and oil.
Spread on a lined tray in a single layer.
Bake at 220°C for 15-18 minutes, turning halfway, until the chicken is fully cooked.
Arrange the rice in a serving bowl, add the chicken and vegetables on top, garnish with avocado and coriander and serve.

name.en: Baked Salmon Salad with Lemon Vinaigrette

en: Salmon fillet 140 g
Mixed lettuce, chopped, and cherry tomatoes, halved
Sliced cucumber and sliced avocado, 60 g total
Lemon juice 2 tbsp and 1 tsp olive oil for the dressing
Dijon mustard half a tsp for the dressing
Salt and black pepper
Season the salmon with salt and black pepper, bake at 200°C for 15-18 minutes until fully cooked.
Arrange the lettuce, tomatoes, cucumber and avocado in a serving bowl.
Mix the lemon juice, oil and mustard to make the dressing.
Arrange the salmon over the salad, pour the dressing and serve.
170 g chicken breast
1 medium sweet potato
2 tbsp low-sugar BBQ sauce
1 tsp paprika, garlic powder
1 tsp oil, salt
Slice the sweet potato and bake at 200°C for 20 minutes
Season the chicken with paprika, garlic and salt
Grill 6 minutes per side, then brush with the sauce
Serve with the sweet potato slices
150 g lean minced turkey
1 cup cooked kidney beans
2 tomatoes, 1 onion, 1 bell pepper, chopped
1 tsp cumin, chilli powder
1 tsp oil, salt
Brown the turkey in the oil 5 minutes
Add the onion and pepper, sauté 4 minutes
Add the tomatoes, spices, beans and half a cup of water
Simmer 25 minutes until it thickens

name.en: Baked Salmon with Asparagus and Lemon

en: Salmon fillet 140 g
Fresh asparagus, tough ends trimmed, 150 g
1 crushed garlic clove and lemon juice 2 tbsp
1 tsp olive oil, salt and black pepper
Thin lemon slices for garnish
Chopped fresh herbs (dill or parsley) for garnish
Place the salmon fillet in the centre of a lined baking tray, arrange the asparagus around it.
Mix the garlic, lemon juice, oil, salt and black pepper, brush over the salmon and asparagus.
Place the lemon slices over the salmon.
Bake at 200°C for 15-18 minutes until the salmon is cooked and the asparagus is tender, garnish with fresh herbs and serve.
Lean minced beef 140 g
Chopped onion and 1 crushed garlic clove
Whole-wheat breadcrumbs 2 tbsp and 1 egg
Light tomato sauce 2 tbsp (1 for the mixture, 1 for topping)
Salt, black pepper and mixed dried herbs half a tsp
Boiled and mashed potato 150 g with a little low-fat milk
Mix the minced beef with the onion, garlic, breadcrumbs, egg, one tablespoon of tomato sauce, salt, black pepper and herbs until combined.
Shape into an oval loaf on a lined baking tray, brush the top with the remaining tomato sauce.
Bake at 200°C for 35-40 minutes until fully cooked.
Mash the boiled potato with a little milk until smooth, serve with slices of the baked meatloaf.
Chicken breast, flattened, 140 g
Whole-wheat breadcrumbs 40 g and grated parmesan 2 tbsp for coating
Egg white for brushing
Light tomato sauce 60 g
Low-fat grated mozzarella 30 g
A pinch of dried oregano, salt and black pepper
Season the chicken with salt and black pepper.
Mix the breadcrumbs, parmesan and oregano, dip the chicken in the egg white then in the breadcrumb mixture to coat fully.
Arrange on a lined tray, bake at 200°C for 15 minutes.
Remove, spread the tomato sauce and mozzarella over it, return to the oven for another 10-12 minutes until the cheese melts and the chicken is fully cooked.
Lean pork chop 140 g
Apple, cut into thick slices, 150 g
Onion, thinly sliced
A pinch of ground cinnamon and lemon juice 1 tsp
Dried thyme half a tsp and 1 tsp olive oil
Salt and black pepper
Season the pork chop with salt, black pepper and thyme.
Arrange on a lined tray, arrange the apple and onion slices around it.
Mix the lemon juice, cinnamon and oil, brush over the apple and onion.
Bake at 200°C for 20-25 minutes until the pork is fully cooked and the apple is tender, serve hot.
1 large bell pepper, halved and hollowed
Cooked, shredded chicken breast 100 g
Cooked brown rice 80 g
Diced tomato and chopped onion
Mixed spice half a tsp, salt and black pepper
Low-fat grated cheese 20 g for topping (optional)
Mix the shredded chicken with the rice, tomato, onion, mixed spice, salt and black pepper.
Stuff the two pepper halves with the mixture.
Arrange on a lined tray, sprinkle with cheese if desired.
Bake at 200°C for 25-30 minutes until the pepper is cooked and tender, serve hot.
Cod fillet 140 g
Zucchini, red bell pepper and cherry tomatoes, cut, 200 g total
1 crushed garlic clove and lemon juice 2 tbsp
1 tsp olive oil, salt and black pepper
Mixed dried herbs half a tsp
Chopped parsley for garnish (optional)
Arrange the fish fillet in the centre of a lined baking tray, arrange the vegetables around it.
Mix the garlic, lemon juice, oil, herbs, salt and black pepper, brush over the fish and vegetables.
Bake at 200°C for 18-20 minutes until the fish is cooked and flaky and the vegetables are tender.
Garnish with parsley if desired and serve hot.

name.en: Baked Turkey Meatballs with Marinara and Zucchini Noodles

en: Lean minced turkey 140 g
Grated onion and 1 crushed garlic clove
Whole-wheat breadcrumbs 2 tbsp and 1 egg
Dried oregano half a tsp, salt and black pepper
Light tomato sauce (marinara) 100 g
Zucchini, cut into thin noodles with a peeler or spiralizer, 200 g
Mix the minced turkey with the onion, garlic, breadcrumbs, egg, oregano, salt and black pepper until it binds together.
Shape into small balls, arrange on a lined tray.
Bake at 200°C for 18-20 minutes until fully cooked.
Heat the marinara sauce with the meatballs, cook the zucchini noodles in a pan for 2-3 minutes until slightly softened, serve the meatballs and sauce over the zucchini noodles.

name.en: Baked BBQ Pulled Chicken with Coleslaw

en: Chicken breast 140 g
Light BBQ sauce 2 tbsp
Whole-wheat bread, 1 loaf (60 g) (optional to serve)
Shredded cabbage 100 g and shredded carrot 30 g for the slaw
Low-fat Greek yogurt 2 tbsp and lemon juice 1 tsp for the slaw
Salt and black pepper
Season the chicken breast with salt and black pepper, bake at 200°C for 20-25 minutes until fully cooked.
Shred the baked chicken with two forks, mix with the BBQ sauce.
Mix the cabbage and carrot with the yogurt, lemon juice, salt and black pepper to make the coleslaw.
Serve the pulled chicken with the coleslaw and bread if desired.
1 medium apple, sliced
2 tbsp natural peanut butter
A pinch of cinnamon
Chia seeds (optional)
Slice the apple into medium-thick pieces
Arrange them on a plate in a circle
Put the peanut butter in a small bowl for dipping
Sprinkle with cinnamon and chia seeds
10 g raw almonds
10 g walnuts
5 g raisins
5 g dried cranberries
A pinch of cinnamon (optional)
Put the almonds and walnuts in a bowl
Add the raisins and dried cranberries
Sprinkle cinnamon if you like and toss
Store in a sealed bag in measured portions
Sweet potato, sliced very thin, 200 g
1 tsp olive oil
A little salt
A pinch of paprika or black pepper (optional)
Mix the sweet potato slices with the oil, salt and paprika if desired until evenly coated.
Arrange in a single layer on a lined tray without overlapping.
Bake at 160°C for 25-30 minutes, turning halfway, until golden and crisp.
Let cool 5 minutes before serving to become crispier.
Low-fat Greek yogurt 150 g
Fresh or frozen mixed berries (strawberries and blueberries) 60 g
Lightly toasted rolled oats 2 tbsp
Honey 1 tsp
A pinch of ground cinnamon (optional)
Place half the yogurt in a serving glass or bowl.
Add half the berries and half the toasted oats.
Repeat with another layer of yogurt, berries and oats.
Drizzle with honey and sprinkle with cinnamon if desired, serve immediately.
Zucchini, sliced very thin, 200 g
Whole-wheat breadcrumbs 20 g and grated parmesan 1 tbsp
Egg white for brushing
A pinch of dried oregano
A little salt and black pepper
Mix the breadcrumbs, parmesan, oregano, salt and black pepper.
Dip the zucchini slices in the egg white then in the breadcrumb mixture.
Arrange in a single layer on a lined tray without overlapping.
Bake at 180°C for 20-25 minutes, turning halfway, until golden and crisp.
2 hard-boiled eggs
Low-fat Greek yogurt 1 tbsp
Dijon mustard half a tsp and a little lemon juice
A pinch of paprika for garnish
Salt and black pepper
Chopped parsley for garnish (optional)
Cut the hard-boiled eggs lengthwise in half, gently remove the yolks and place in a small bowl.
Mash the yolks with the yogurt, mustard, lemon juice, salt and black pepper until smooth.
Fill the egg whites with the yolk mixture using a small spoon or piping bag.
Sprinkle with paprika and parsley if desired and serve cold.
Fresh kale, leaves torn off the stems, 80 g
1 tsp olive oil
A little salt
A pinch of paprika or garlic powder (optional)
Dry the kale leaves thoroughly, mix with the oil, salt and paprika if desired.
Spread on a lined tray in a single layer without overlapping.
Bake at 150°C for 15-18 minutes, turning halfway, until crisp without burning.
Let cool slightly before serving to become crispier.
Canned chickpeas, drained, 100 g
1 crushed garlic clove and lemon juice 1 tbsp
Tahini 1 tsp and 1 tsp olive oil
Carrot, cucumber and bell pepper, cut into sticks, 150 g total
Salt and ground cumin a pinch
Blend the chickpeas, garlic, lemon juice, tahini, oil, salt and cumin in a food processor until smooth and creamy.
Add a little water if needed for a smoother texture.
Place the hummus in a serving bowl or cup.
Arrange the vegetable sticks around it or dip them in and serve.
Canned chickpeas, drained and dried well, 200 g
1 tsp olive oil
Paprika, garlic powder and ground cumin a quarter tsp each
A little salt
A pinch of cayenne pepper (optional)
Dry the chickpeas thoroughly with a paper towel to remove as much moisture as possible.
Mix them with the oil, paprika, garlic powder, cumin, salt and cayenne pepper if desired.
Arrange in a single layer on a lined tray.
Bake at 200°C for 30-35 minutes, stirring every 10 minutes, until fully crisp, let cool before serving.

name.en: Cucumber Bites with Cream Cheese and Smoked Salmon

en: Cucumber, cut into thick slices, 150 g
Low-fat cream cheese 40 g
Smoked salmon, cut into small pieces, 30 g
A little chopped fresh dill and a little lemon juice
A pinch of black pepper
Arrange the cucumber slices on a serving plate.
Place a small spoonful of cream cheese on top of each slice.
Place a piece of smoked salmon on top of the cheese.
Sprinkle with dill, lemon juice and black pepper and serve immediately.
2 bananas, sliced and frozen
1 tsp peanut butter
A pinch of cinnamon
A few drops of vanilla
A dusting of cocoa (optional)
Freeze the banana slices for at least 3 hours
Blitz them in a food processor
Add the peanut butter and vanilla, blend until creamy
Serve at once, dusted with cinnamon or cocoa
150 g low-fat cottage cheese
Half cup chopped strawberries and pineapple
1 tsp honey
1 tbsp crushed walnuts
A pinch of cinnamon
Put the cottage cheese in a serving bowl
Arrange the strawberries and pineapple on top
Drizzle the honey and scatter the walnuts and cinnamon
Serve at once
Apple, sliced, 150 g
Ground cinnamon half a tsp and lemon juice 1 tsp
Oats 30 g and whole-wheat flour 1 tbsp
Brown sugar 1 tbsp
Melted low-fat butter 1 tbsp
Coarsely chopped walnuts 1 tsp (optional)
Mix the apple slices with the cinnamon and lemon juice, place in a small oven-safe dish.
Mix the oats, flour, brown sugar, melted butter and walnuts if desired until a crumbly texture forms.
Spread the oat mixture over the apples.
Bake at 180°C for 25-30 minutes until golden on top and the apples are tender, serve warm.
Ripe avocado, mashed, 100 g
Unsweetened raw cocoa powder 2 tbsp
Honey or maple syrup 2 tbsp
Low-fat milk 2 tbsp
Vanilla extract half a tsp
A pinch of salt
Mash the avocado thoroughly until smooth without lumps.
Add the cocoa, honey, milk, vanilla and salt.
Mix well until the texture is smooth and creamy (a blender can be used for a smoother texture).
Pour into a serving cup and chill in the fridge for at least 30 minutes before serving.
Peach, sliced (fresh or canned, drained), 150 g
Ground cinnamon half a tsp and lemon juice 1 tsp
Oats 30 g and whole-wheat flour 1 tbsp
Brown sugar 1 tbsp
Melted low-fat butter 1 tbsp
A pinch of vanilla extract (optional)
Mix the peach slices with the cinnamon and lemon juice, place in a small oven-safe dish.
Mix the oats, flour, brown sugar, melted butter and vanilla if desired until a crumbly texture forms.
Spread the oat mixture over the peaches.
Bake at 180°C for 25-30 minutes until golden on top and the peaches are tender, serve warm.
Oats 40 g
Natural peanut butter 2 tbsp
Honey 2 tbsp
A pinch of vanilla extract
A pinch of ground cinnamon (optional)
Chia or sesame seeds 1 tsp (optional)
Mix the oats with the peanut butter, honey, vanilla and cinnamon if desired in a bowl until the texture combines and becomes sticky.
Let the mixture rest 10 minutes in the fridge to make it easier to shape.
Shape into small bite-sized balls using slightly damp hands.
Roll in chia or sesame seeds if desired, keep refrigerated and enjoy as a snack.
Canned pumpkin puree 100 g
1 egg and 1 egg white
Low-fat milk 80 ml
Brown sugar 2 tbsp
Ground cinnamon half a tsp and a pinch of ground cloves
Vanilla extract half a tsp
Whisk the egg and egg white with the milk, brown sugar, cinnamon, cloves and vanilla.
Add the pumpkin puree and mix until the texture is smooth.
Pour into a small oven-safe dish.
Bake at 170°C for 30-35 minutes until set (still slightly jiggly in the centre), let cool before serving.
Oats 70 g
Fresh or frozen blueberries 80 g
Half a mashed banana
1 egg
Ground cinnamon half a tsp and vanilla extract half a tsp
Honey 2 tbsp
Mix the oats with the mashed banana, egg, cinnamon, vanilla and honey until combined.
Gently fold in the blueberries.
Pour into a small oven-safe dish lined with baking paper, spread evenly.
Bake at 180°C for 25-30 minutes until golden on top and set, let cool completely then cut into bars.
Oats 50 g
Finely grated carrot 40 g
Natural peanut butter or almond butter 2 tbsp
Honey 2 tbsp
Ground cinnamon half a tsp and a pinch of ground cloves
Coarsely chopped raisins 1 tbsp (optional)
Mix the oats with the grated carrot, peanut butter, honey, cinnamon, cloves and raisins if desired in a bowl until the texture combines and becomes sticky.
Let the mixture rest 10 minutes in the fridge to make it easier to shape.
Shape into small bite-sized balls using slightly damp hands.
Keep refrigerated and enjoy as a snack.
Low-fat cottage cheese, well drained, 150 g
Powdered sugar 30 g
1 egg
Vanilla extract half a tsp and lemon juice 1 tsp
Finely crushed oat biscuits 20 g for the base (optional)
Fresh berries for garnish (optional)
Blend the cottage cheese with the powdered sugar, egg, vanilla and lemon juice in a food processor until smooth and creamy.
Distribute the crushed oat biscuits in the bottom of small lined muffin tins if desired.
Pour the cheese mixture over them.
Bake at 170°C for 18-20 minutes until set (the centre remains slightly jiggly), let cool then chill in the fridge for an hour before serving, garnish with berries if desired.
